items.title: Formal etaleness is equivalent to the vanishing of both cohomology sheaves of the naive cotangent complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises formal etaleness of a morphism by the vanishing of the two cohomology sheaves of its naive cotangent complex. The two sides of the statement are literally identical in the two chapters, so this card supplies the missing side's registry entry; the proof on this side is a genuine derivation from the formal smooth and unramified cases combined through the formal etale characterisation. Retained author proof at lines 5480-5492.
